text.description_html:
DSB4540B4 Deltana 4 1/2" x 4" Solid Brass Hinge.

Square Corners, 4 Ball Bearings. 0.134" thick (gauge).

Package includes a pair of hinges, matching solid brass flathead, Phillips screws and standard removable button tip finials.

Fitted with a high grade, removable, rust resistant, stainless steel pin.

Utilizes template screw hole pattern for use with wood or metal doors.

No matter which finish you choose, the Hinge will still be high quality solid brass.

This item is discontinued. Please use Bommer 4-1/2 x 4 Brass Hinge.
